 Print 'Ranabaali' box office collection day 21. Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's 'Ranabaali' is struggling to maintain its theatrical momentum after a promising start. The historical drama, which opened with Rs 9.25 cr in India net collections, has witnessed a steep decline in daily earnings. On its 21st day, the movie managed just Rs 12 lakh net. This marked a 42.9% drop compared with the previous day's collection. The film's latest figures highlight the slowdown following its initial box office success. Despite the considerable fall in daily earnings, 'Ranabaali' has accumulated Rs 58.98 cr in India net collections. Its domestic gross stands at Rs 68.48 cr, while the worldwide gross has reached Rs 80.59 cr. Overseas territories have contributed Rs 12.35 cr, accounting for 15.3% of the global earnings. The Indian market continues to dominate, contributing 84.7% of the worldwide total, as per Sacnilk. 'Ranabaali' box office collection: Strong opening week
 The Vijay Deverakonda-starrer began its theatrical journey on a promising note. During its first seven days, the film collected Rs 45.20 cr in India net earnings. Its domestic gross collection reached Rs 52.55 cr during the same period. The opening week accounted for the biggest share of the movie's domestic earnings. The initial audience response helped the historical drama establish a strong position at the ticket windows. However, the momentum proved difficult to sustain as the film entered its second week. The movie experienced a considerable reduction in earnings during its second week. Between Days 8 and 14, 'Ranabaali' added Rs 12.10 cr net to its domestic total. Its corresponding gross collection stood at Rs 14 cr. This represented a 73.2% decline compared with the opening week. Third week proves particularly challenging
 The slowdown became more pronounced during the third week. Between Days 15 and 21, the movie managed to collect only Rs 1.68 cr net in India. Its gross earnings for the period stood at Rs 1.93 cr. The third-week performance represented an 86.1% decline from the preceding week. This sharp reduction has affected the film's ability to add substantially to its domestic total. Although its worldwide earnings remain above Rs 80 cr, the latest weekly figures indicate a significant loss of theatrical momentum. Day 21 collection: Occupancy and show count
 On Thursday, November 5, 'Ranabaali' recorded just Rs 12 lakh net and Rs 13 lakh gross in India. The daily earnings declined by 42.9% compared with Wednesday's performance. The film registered 182 shows across the country, with an overall occupancy of 16%. The latest numbers suggest that the movie is nearing the closing phase of its theatrical run. Its daily collections have fallen substantially from the opening-day figure. 'Ranabaali': Story, cast and crew
 Set during the Madras Famine of 1876–1878 in the Rayalaseema region, 'Ranabaali' explores the impact of British colonial rule. The narrative revolves around a horseman who rises against the authorities and leads a fierce local resistance. The historical setting provides the backdrop for a story of rebellion, hardship and defiance. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the film features Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna in the lead roles. Arnold Vosloo is also part of the cast. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. This data is provided by us for informational and entertainment purposes only.
